title: ML-CLAPPS: A Probabilistic Framework for Imbalanced Multilabel Learning under Class Prioritization
abstract: arXiv:2610.15816v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world datasets often exhibit severe class imbalance, degrading the performance of deep learning models, particularly on rare classes. While imbalance is well studied in binary and multiclass settings, it is substantially more challenging in multilabel problems due to complex label co-occurrence. In clinical applications such as ECG classification, this challenge is coupled with a second critical challenge: the need to prioritize high-risk conditions, regardless of their prevalence, to mitigate the high cost of false negatives. We introduce the Multilabel Class-Prioritized Probabilistic Sampler (ML-CLAPPS), a learnable sampler that optimizes a distribution over training instances to control the model's exposure to different classes. This approach addresses multilabel imbalance while enabling prioritization of significant conditions via a user-defined importance vector (IV). Empirical evaluation on a real-world multilabel ECG image

translated_title: ML-CLAPPS：类别优先级下不平衡多标签学习的概率框架
translated_abstract: 真实世界的数据集通常表现出严重的类别不平衡，这会降低深度学习模型的性能，尤其是在稀有类别上。虽然不平衡问题在二分类和多分类设置中已得到充分研究，但由于标签共现关系的复杂性，该问题在多标签场景中更具挑战性。在心电图（ECG）分类等临床应用中，这一挑战还叠加了另一个关键难题：无论高风险病症的流行程度如何，都需要对其进行优先处理，以降低假阴性带来的高昂代价。我们提出了多标签类别优先概率采样器（ML-CLAPPS），这是一种可学习的采样器，通过优化训练实例上的分布来控制模型对不同类别的暴露程度。该方法在解决多标签不平衡问题的同时，还能通过用户定义的重要性向量（IV）实现对重要病症的优先处理。在真实世界多标签心电图图像上的实证评估……
tldr: 提出了ML-CLAPPS，一种可学习的概率采样框架，通过优化训练实例的分布来应对多标签类别不平衡问题，并借助用户定义的重要性向量实现对高风险病症（如心电图分类中的关键病症）的优先处理。
en_tdlr: ML-CLAPPS is a learnable probabilistic sampler that tackles multilabel class imbalance by optimizing the distribution over training instances, while enabling prioritization of high-risk conditions through a user-defined importance vector.
